text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3 deferred migration. Pipeline public API/artifact and tests remain in current build, with fit test-scope dependency, so it has not been retired. Do not equate sparse internal usage with no external consumers or delete it without the declared API/test migration matrix. The no-new-product-orchestration direction is consistent with the accepted boundary; reusable scientific reference execution and defect fixes can continue without building a second persisted app workflow authority. On resumption inspect current consumer imports and upstream replacement evidence, classify graph/ordering/failure/resource laws by actual owner, then define removal/compatibility policy. Native archive transaction primitives are not part of a blanket pipeline retirement. No deletion, deprecation or migration proof in this assessment.
